assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: optional conceptual editorial background still for the Ichido speaking-practice promo, landscape 16:9, highest available resolution.
Primary request: create a premium architectural studio photograph/render of a quiet minimal private practice room. This is a metaphorical environment, not a real product feature or real office.
Scene/backdrop: warm paper-colored #f4f1e9 plaster room, a single elegant rounded arch or deep alcove toward the right, tactile limewashed surfaces with subtle real detail. No extra furniture is necessary.
Subject: one sculptural cobalt #2848e8 ribbon positioned within or just in front of the alcove on the right, flowing in open free-ended folds, thin closely layered edges, satin sculpted material. Its character should feel like the website's cobalt folded sound ribbon: organic disciplined loops, true blue, material rather than digital.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 editorial frame at human eye height, calm perspective, architecture and sculpture primarily occupying right 45 percent. The entire left 50 percent must be generous clean wall negative space suitable for editable typography to be added later. Carefully balanced margins, sculpture uncropped.
Lighting/mood: diffuse afternoon natural light from an unseen side source, soft believable contact shadows, quiet personal room, exceptionally refined and restrained.
Materials/textures: tactile plaster, subtle matte mineral floor, cobalt satin ribbon with fine physical edge layering; physically plausible photoreal rendering.
Constraints: no people, computer, microphone, text, letters, logos, watermark, UI, charts, or fabricated product screens. No plants, no gratuitous props, no excessive ornament. No neon, holograms, chrome, or glowing blue effects. Render one cohesive image, not a collage or contact sheet.

assets.prompt:

selection_policy: Optional supporting concepts. Opus may discard either image. Product truth must come from actual screenshots and captured footage; generated images must not stand in for app screens or measured charts.
animation_suggestion: Only restrained transform, crop, opacity, or layered compositing unless new depth/masks/3D geometry are created and reviewed. Do not invent parallax layers or data inside the still.
